title: Version 1.10: Dev Mode and Teams Mode
description: Released July 26, 2026, adding Dev Mode and Teams Mode with enhanced chat experience featuring better models, better context, and more control over features. The Windsurf Plugin (non-agentic AI coding tool) was deprecated effective July 1, 2026 for government/WOG users.

title: July 17, 2026 Changelog: Side Chats, Team MCP, and Mobile App
description: Major update introducing Side Chats for parallel conversations without interrupting main agent, Conversation Search with local indexing, Team MCP servers in team marketplaces for admins to configure once and distribute across organization, Cloud Agent hooks for observing and controlling agent conversations, and Cursor Mobile App for iOS in public beta with Remote Control and Live Activities support.

title: Version 0.144.4 Maintenance Patch
description: Released July 14, 2026, as a maintenance patch with no user-facing changes. Update includes bug fixes related to dangerous-command detection with clearer command rejection reasons, building on the 'Spring Wave' of updates from earlier in 2026.

title: Visual Studio June Update: Visibility and Trust Features
description: Released July 14, 2026, focusing on visibility and trust with a clearer view of GitHub Copilot usage tracking and alerts, new trust validation for MCP servers that compares configuration and asset fingerprint against trusted baseline at startup, first C++ scenarios for modernization agent reaching general availability, long-distance next edit suggestions, and ability to add pull requests to Copilot Chat for context.

community_feedback.quote: Visual Studio 2026 copilot experience is horrible... the responses in the chat are ugly very often broken where markdown is shown as text and text is shown as markdown line spacing is oddly large
We heard your feedback: seeing IntelliSense and Copilot completions at the same time can be distracting

title: 50% Higher Weekly Limits Extended Through July 19
description: Anthropic extended a limited-time promotion increasing weekly usage limits in Claude Code by 50%. The promotion, which began in May 2026, was valid through July 19, 2026, at 11:59 PM PT. The CLI, app, and desktop releases were described as continuing to 'fill a lot of the gaps' in the product.

title: Version 0.50.0: Tool Registry Discovery and Release Verification
description: Released July 8, 2026, introducing tool registry discovery capabilities to automatically detect and register available tools, enhanced release verification by ignoring scripts during verification to prevent workspace binary shadowing, and safeguarding against bad NPM releases. Preview version 0.51.0-preview.0 also released with robust path & API updates.
